arStrings.szText: "Will the Great Serpent not defend the Tree?"

PLAYER LEAD IN: "Will the Great Serpent not defend the Tree?" - For Taissa, this is a big deal, but she plays it matter-of-factly. The Serpent was a GIANT snake that guarded the Tree earlier in the story.
Curious. He doesn't have strong feelings about the Serpent. This revelation is more of a curiousity to him.
Without a trace. We can only guess why...but just before it vanished, I felt a clearing in the air. As though an evil weight had lifted from the chest of the world.
Taissa muses on the feeling of when the Great Serpent disappeared.
Whatever it was, perhaps the Serpent felt it too...and decided it was no longer needed here.
